crossRefs.note: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as…
The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

parallels.note: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

translations.web: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”
translations.bsb: Therefore what God has joined together, let man not separate.”
translations.kjv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
translations.asv: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
